correctness.rationale: Leaf stripping on any forest makes all edge inner-product variables mutually independent, since the conditional distribution of a leaf dot product is rotation-invariant and does not depend on other vertex spins. A simple j-cycle has product moment p^(1-j) by E[R R^T]=I/p. Proper nonempty cycle subsets are forests, so their mixed joint cumulant vanishes; cumulant multilinearity implies all lower-order mixed defects vanish, and at r=g exactly g! orderings of each shortest cycle contribute p^(1-g) times its weight product. Positivity precludes signed cancellation. For Haar qubit p=3, Bloch representation and fourth/fifth repeated-edge cumulants yield kappa_2=m/3, kappa_3=2c3/3, kappa_4=-2m/15+8c4/9, kappa_5=-8c3/3+40c5/27. Finite simple graphs, p>=2, nonzero real weights in the identity, positive weights to identify girth; no graph-isomorphism reconstruction is claimed.
